notes.title: Future of the game
notes.content:
A couple of days are left before the release of the first episode of One Night In The House.

[h1]Second episode?[/h1]

The second episode will be distributed as a free update. Its development will begin in mid-September.

At the moment, we are busy with a new project about which we will talk soon.

Thanks to everyone who adds One Night In The House to their Steam wish list.

notes.title: Date of release
notes.content:
The release is scheduled for August 29th at 10:00 PST.
The game will cost $1.99, but the first week there will be a 10% discount
